title: Settings map has leaked into server; add mailer without spreading it
task: Add a `mailer` package that builds its SMTP address and sender from `SMTP_HOST`, `SMTP_PORT`, and `SMTP_FROM` out of the same settings the server reads, with `Send(to, body string) error` writing `From: ...`, `To: ...`, and the body to an `io.Writer` for now. The raw map from `settings.Load` has already reached `server`; do not let it spread any further, and leave `settings` and `server` better than you found them.
